key_values.event_name: 2015 Southeast Asia haze from Indonesian fires

report_anchor_semantics.psi_peak_reported_above: uses 2000 as the benchmark anchor for a report phrase saying PSI soared above 2000
report_anchor_semantics.psi_hazardous_threshold: uses 350 as the benchmark anchor for a report phrase saying any score above 350 is hazardous
report_anchor_semantics.co_peak_nearly: uses 1300 as the benchmark anchor for a report phrase saying surface CO reached nearly 1300 ppb
report_anchor_semantics.co_usual_about: uses 100 as the benchmark anchor for a report phrase saying usual CO is about 100 ppb
report_anchor_semantics.exposed_people_min: uses 43 million as the lower-bound exposure anchor for a report phrase saying more than 43 million were exposed

key_values.service_marker_context_note: OSM/WorldPop service-marker density is a package-derived receptor-context statistic, not an event-time facility impact count.

event.event_name: 2015 Southeast Asia haze from Indonesian fires

provenance.notes: Source values are extracted deterministically from local event data.

criteria.name: Final JSON and label
criteria.description: Returns the six requested fields and the final label smoke_threshold_confirmed with threshold_pass_count equal to 4.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2 points for the correct label with missing or malformed fields; give 1 point for a plausible threshold result with the wrong pass count.

criteria.name: PSI and carbon monoxide ratios
criteria.description: Computes benchmark-anchor ratios 2000 / 350 = 5.714 and 1300 / 100 = 13.0, with correct rounding and pass states.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2 points for one correct ratio and pass state; give 3 points for both ratios with minor rounding or unit wording errors.

criteria.name: Respiratory-case rate
criteria.description: Computes the benchmark rate 500000 / 43 = 11627.907 cases per exposed million from the report's case anchor and exposed-population lower-bound anchor, then marks the test as passed.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 to 2 points for using the correct inputs but dividing by total people rather than millions, rounding poorly, or omitting the pass comparison.

criteria.name: Local service-marker density
criteria.description: Sums the package-derived service-context markers to 57, divides by 573590.9458804413, multiplies by 100000, obtains 9.937, and marks the context-density test as passed without treating markers as event-time facility impacts.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for the correct marker sum only; give 2 points for the correct rate with a minor category or rounding error.

criteria.name: Threshold arithmetic
criteria.description: Applies the four thresholds exactly and derives the final rule from at least three passing tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 to 2 points for correct arithmetic with one threshold comparison or final-rule mistake.

criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.description: Gives a concise interpretation tied to the four computed values and avoids turning local service counts into confirmed facility harm.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for a mostly numeric answer with a vague or overstated interpretation.

criteria.name: Concise answer format
criteria.description: Keeps the answer compact and uses the requested field names.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 0.5 points for a correct answer embedded in unnecessary prose.
